articleTitle: The Loss Optimization for the Active Distribution System Considering the Renewable Distributed Generation
publicationTitle: 2023 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Due to the penetration of the renewable distributed generation, the operating mode and economy of the distribution system is being influencing and changing. Reducing power loss of the distribution system is the important operation requirements. On account of such reason, this paper proposes one power loss optimization model and solution process by sensitivity analysis (SA) algorithm, on the basis of the traditional optimal power flow (OPF) model. The model and solution process is simulated on the 34 node distribution system in North China, and the effectiveness of the algorithm is verified. Within a certain error range, SA algorithm has higher computational efficiency than the traditional OPF optimization process, and it would improve the operation of the active distributed system in practice.

articleTitle: Simulation of Process Decision Model for Die and Mold Parts Based on BP Neural Network Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: With the continuous progress of scie & tech, all walks of life have higher and higher requirements for the precision and fineness of products, especially in the fields of medicine, mold and so on, which require precise processing lines or excellent surface quality to meet specific requirements. At present, there are many shortcomings in the mold processing technology, such as the choice of processing path, the choice of cutting tools and the setting of cutting parameters. In this paper, the optimization of numerical control (NC) milling process for die parts is discussed, the development and characteristics of NC technology and the optimization of basic flow of NC programming for die parts are introduced, and the decision-making model of NC milling process for die parts based on back propagation neural network (BPNN) algorithm is constructed, and the optimization method of NC milling process for die parts is put forward. Simulation results show that the detection rate of this method can reach 98.81%, and the false alarm rate is 1.28%. This verifies the effectiveness of the optimization algorithm of die parts processing technology in this paper. In order to better optimize the technological effect of computer numerical control (CNC) milling die parts, it is necessary to optimize and control each process and key points in order to avoid the possible serious deviation.

articleTitle: Image Processing Technology Analysis Based on Artificial Intelligence Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: In computer vision research, the task of image segmentation based on artificial intelligence (AI) has become the focus. Image segmentation refers to the technology and process of dividing an image into several regions, each of which has unique properties, and extracting objects of interest. It plays an important role in image processing engineering. This paper proposes an image segmentation algorithm based on DAtt-U-Net network. This paper enhances U-Net by switching out the original convolution with the D-Perception multi-scale feature extraction module, which decreases the quantity of netwoark parameters while multi-scale feature extraction, in order to correctly divide the picture region under complicated backdrop. The leap link portion of the initial network is enhanced with the addition of the attention mechanism SE (Att-SE) module, which reduces the issue of picture weight dispersion and noise brought on by upsampling. This paper validates the proposed DAtt-U-Net segmentation algorithm on two datasets, and compares it with other mainstream segmentation networks through experiments. The MIoU value reaches 76.5% and 75.8%. The experimental results show that the proposed algorithm performs well in both segmentation accuracy and pixel segmentation accuracy, with a segmentation accuracy of 91.9% in the MTID dataset, and has strong advantages and competitiveness compared to other popular semantic segmentation networks. The image segmentation algorithm proposed in this work effectively improves segmentation performance.

articleTitle: Quantum K-Means Model based on Optimization Framework
publicationTitle: 2023 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: The Quantum K-means clustering algorithm offers the advantage of quantum parallel computing, but suffers from issues related to cluster center initialization and sensitivity to noisy data due to its similarity with the K-means clustering algorithm. To address these challenges, we propose a quantum K-means model based on an optimization framework. Specifi-cally, we use a quantum genetic algorithm with pin optimization to adjust the fitness function for the Quantum K-means clustering algorithm. The optimally adapted quantum genetic algorithm reduces the sensitivity of cluster center initialization and improves the noise robustness of the Quantum K-means clus-tering algorithm using a noise reduction self-encoder. As a result, the proposed model achieves better clustering performance even in the presence of noise. Experimental results demonstrate that our proposed quantum K-means model has fewer clustering iterations, lower probability of falling into local optima, and improved noise robustness after optimizing the clustering cen-ters. The model's effectiveness in clustering is also demon-strated experimentally.

articleTitle: Multi-terminal Optical Fiber Tuning Method for Distribution Network Relay Protection Based on Reinforcement Learning Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: With social progress and rapid economic development, the scale of distribution network is expanding day by day. The construction of new power systems, and a large number of new energy distributed power sources such as wind, light, and storage are connected. The single-source single-flow grid structure is gradually changing to multi-source and multi-flow grid architecture, and the traditional protection and self-healing modes are no longer suitable for the requirements of complex distribution network systems. The distribution network has higher and higher requirements for safe operation. On the premise of ensuring the selectivity and sensitivity of the distribution network current differential protection, it is necessary to study a simpler, low-cost effective protection system. For this reason, this paper studies and analyzes the reinforcement learning algorithm, and applies it to the multi-terminal optical fiber tuning method for distribution network relay protection. Through exploration and simulation, a fiber optic current distribution network relay protection system is realized, and the characteristics, composition and reliability of the system are simulated and analyzed, and its feasibility is verified.

articleTitle: Analogy of Slotless Motor Classification
publicationTitle: 2023 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: This article explains the classification of adjustable drive systems by examining slotless motors and comparing them to slotted motors. As motors evolve, so does their design, offering new technologies to improve engine efficiency and make torque smoother, and one of those solutions is the slotless engine design, which doesn't have a division in the common electric motor analogy. The paper also describes electric motors, which are listed in general analogy, with emphasis on slotless motors. Such motors are commonly called brushless DC motors, brushless AC motors, permanent magnet synchronous motors or servo motors. The article includes a description of the advantages of brushless motor designs compared to classic DC and AC motors, using the method of comparing motor characteristics, designs and properties. Brushless permanent magnet motors are available in a variety of shapes and sizes that can provide both rotary and linear motion with higher precision than slotted motors. They are characterized by high torque density and high efficiency. The article is useful for researchers, electrical engineers and electrical drive students studying drive systems and especially brushless motor electric drive systems.

articleTitle: An End-to-End Convolutional Neural Network Model for Autonomous Driving
publicationTitle: 2023 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: The paper attempts to provide a feasible end-to-end convolutional neural networks (CNN) model for the studying of autonomous driving system. The remarkable advances in machine learning have empowered methods to autonomous driving, and the end-to-end approach outperforms the modular one. Under CNN technology, the model aims to learn the entire driving process from sensors to control commands. The paper describes the theoretical foundation and steps involved in training models based on CNN and the simulation platform used. Subsequently, the paper presents an investigation of some hyperparameters, namely dropout rate, activation function, and learning rate. Finally, it discusses the evaluation metrics to assess the performance of the trained models. This essay also highlights progress in the field of autonomous driving and demonstrates its potential for future advancements.

articleTitle: Research on target detection and tracking algorithm of football game video based on deep learning
publicationTitle: 2023 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Sports programs are popular with the public because of their unique attraction. Therefore, it is of great significance and economic value to analyze and study the videos in sports events. Taking a football match as an example, this paper studies how to effectively detect and track moving objects on the court. Therefore, it is very necessary to recognize and track the moving objects in football. The existing methods are not ideal for detecting and tracking moving objects in dynamic scenes. On this basis, combined with Kalman filtering technology, a target tracking algorithm based on TMHI is designed. On this basis, using Kalman filtering algorithm, the position of the target mass center and the rectangular area around the target are obtained when the goal is scored, and the target tracking is realized. Experiments show that this algorithm can effectively detect and track moving targets in football videos.

Author Keywords: Target detection in soccer game video

articleTitle: Research on Speech Recognition Algorithm Based on Embedded System Architecture
publicationTitle: 2023 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: In order to improve the application value of speech recognition algorithm in embedded system, the speech recognition algorithm is optimized and designed using the embedded system structure. Under the embedded system structure model, the hardware equipment is used to collect the voice signal, and the initial voice signal is preprocessed through filtering, windowing and framing, endpoint detection and other steps. From the two dimensions of cepstrum domain and time domain, the speech signal features are extracted, and the speech recognition results are obtained by matching with the language template features. Compared with the traditional recognition algorithm, it is concluded that the speech recognition error rate of the optimized design algorithm is reduced by about 1.21% and 0.87% respectively, and the recognition dropout rate is reduced by 1.38% and 0.66% respectively in the environment with and without noise, which proves that the optimized design algorithm has higher recognition performance.

articleTitle: A Multi-Core Verification Method of Vector Instructions Based on Spike
publicationTitle: 2023 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Verifying the instruction execution against a golden execution model following the ISA is becoming a common practice to verify processors. This method plays an important role in the single-core verification scenario. However, for the correctness monitoring of multi-core processors, the uncertainty caused by shared storage makes the above method unable to meet the requirements better. This paper provides a multi-core function verification scheme of vector instructions based on RISC-V architecture, which monitors the instruction execution time of DUT and triggers the reference model in time through Test Bench. This scheme uses Spike, the instruction set standard implementation model specified by RISC-V Foundation, as the reference model of verification environment. It adds a DPI (Direct Programming Interface) interface for the simulation environment to call, modifies the execution mechanism of vector instructions in Spike's existing model, and then triggers the synchronous execution of Spike with the time of the instruction monitored from each core in the DUT (design under test), and finally compares the execution results of the DUT and Spike. From the top level, although there is no adjudication mechanism for the order of multi-core access data in Spike, the time of data acquisition or update of each core is exactly the same as that in the DUT. So that the multi-core comparison verification of vector instructions can be completed in the simulation stage, and more bugs such as vector instructions and multi-core consistency can be found earlier.

articleTitle: A P2PNet based on Adaptively Spatial Feature Fusion and Confidence Differentiation in Crowd Counting and Profiling
publicationTitle: 2023 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: With the in-depth research in the field of crowd counting in recent years, many problems have arisen, such as the diversity of scenes, crowds blocking each other, pedestrians of different sizes, imprecisely labeled datasets, etc., which can cause low performance of counting, thus making it challenging to implement the research in this field, and therefore difficult to meet the needs of realistic scenarios. Therefore, in this paper, we investigate and analyze the above problem and design a crowd-counting model based on improved P2PNet from the perspective of crowd multi-scale. Firstly, Adaptively Spatial Feature Fusion is used to strengthen the perceptual ability of the model for multi-scale targets and alleviate the information conflicts between different feature layers. Then, to improve immunity to fuzzy annotations, a confidence differentiation strategy assigns a unique anchor point to each ground truth point in the matching phase. Finally, the vanilla convolution in the detection head is replaced with circular convolution, which enhances the robustness and reduces the MSE. Experimental results show that under the JHU-CROWD++ dataset, compared with the original model, the MAE is 60.13, which is reduced by about 5.9%, and the MSE is 224.93, which is reduced by about 9%. Moreover, compared with several recent networks on JHU-CROWD++, ShanghaiTech Part_A, and UCF_CC_50, the proposed model possesses a lower error rate, proving the proposed method's effectiveness. The experimental results show that the proposed method effectively alleviates the problem of varying population scales and improves counting accuracy.

articleTitle: D-Transformer: A Deep Learning Model for Time Series Prediction
publicationTitle: 2023 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: The Transformer model is a deep learning model that has been extensively applied across diverse industries since its inception. However, the lack of Transformer models tailored for timing forecasting has led to the development of the proposed D-Transformer model in this study. The D-Transformer model is based on the Duffing equation and enables accurate forecasting of various types of time series data. The D-Transformer model is a type of transformer model that uses a modern and evolving mathematical techniques set, generally known as attention or self-attention. To evaluate the effectiveness of D-Transformer, a comparison was made with the conventional Transformer model. The results demonstrate that D-Transformer exhibits optimal prediction performance on power data sets, thereby validating the superiority of the proposed model over existing methods. In conclusion, the proposed D-Transformer model provides a promising solution for timing forecasting in various industries. Further investigations are warranted to assess the applicability and effectiveness of the model in other domains.

articleTitle: Design and Optimization of Electric Automation Control System for Large Machinery Based on Grey Clustering Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: With the advent of automation era in modern product manufacturing industry, product assembly technology urgently needs to realize automation in order to improve product assembly efficiency, assembly quality and consistency. In mechanical systems, the communication mode is usually bus at the control end and bus at the execution end. The main task of the design and development of an optical-communication module is to convert the communication mode at the control end into optical communication mode and the bus mode at the execution end into optical communication mode, that is, to complete the design and development of the bus-to-photon module and the optical-to-bus submodule. PID controller is often used in the design of power control system. The control effect of PID controller is greatly affected by parameters. The traditional parameter setting method is more complex and difficult to set. An optimal design method of power control system for electrical automation equipment based on grey clustering is proposed. Firstly, the grey clustering is introduced, and then the application of grey clustering in the design of power control system of electrical automation equipment is emphatically studied.

articleTitle: A Multi-objective Assignment Algorithm for UAVs in Multiple Task with Different Workloads
publicationTitle: 2023 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: UAVs have been widely used in military and civilian fields. The research on UAV task assignment mainly involves trajectory planning, task assignment, and specific applications for various scenarios. Moreover, most of the previous studies are for single UAV. Studies for swarm of UAVs are relatively few. In this paper, we focus on the multi-objective assignment algorithm of UAVs for multiple tasks which have homogeneous application scenarios with different locations, same priorities and different workloads. First, a coding method that can simultaneously reflect path planning and task allocation is designed, Based on this, a multiple task assignment algorithm for UAVs swarm is designed, In order to balance the tasks completion time, the workload of each task and the total transfer distance, a multi-objective assignment model is further constructed, and the complete multi-objective UAVs task assignment algorithm is proposed. The task assignment scheme obtained by the algorithm can make the UAVs complete all tasks in a balanced time and resource consumption. The experimental results show that our proposed method can determine the UAVs task assignment plan effectively and efficiently.

articleTitle: Research on Non-destructive Automatic Identification Algorithm of Aircraft Structural Defects Based on Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Nondestructive testing is a new comprehensive applied technology discipline. It can control the product quality in processing and manufacturing and ensure the safe operation of in-service equipment. Nondestructive testing is widely used in machinery, metallurgy, electronics, chemical industry, railway, shipbuilding, nuclear energy, aviation, aerospace, electric power industry and other industries. In the civil aviation system, the aircraft has to undergo a pressurization and decompression in each lifting process, which is easy to fatigue the materials around the rivets fixing the aircraft surface and form radioactive micro cracks. When the crack grows to the critical crack length, it will expand rapidly, and finally lead to structural fracture and failure. The fracture and failure of this structure is also one of the most important reasons for air crash accidents. The research on structural defect detection technology of aging aircraft has been paid more and more attention by aviation organizations all over the world. How to detect the crack defects in the multilayer structure of aging aircraft has always been a difficulty in the field of nondestructive testing. Pulsed eddy current technology is an electromagnetic nondestructive testing technology which can effectively detect defects in multilayer structures. The formula of pulse eddy current penetration depth is deduced theoretically. It is concluded that appropriately reducing the pulse excitation frequency and increasing the duty cycle are conducive to the detection of deep defects. The experimental system and rectangular sensor are designed, and the frequency and duty cycle of the excitation signal are optimized. The inner defects in multilayer structure are tested, and the necessary data processing is carried out for the weak detection signal. The experimental results show that the pulse eddy current testing technology can effectively detect the inner crack defects. Pulsed eddy current technology will play an important role in the field of aviation nondestructive testing. In this paper, aircraft skin defects are taken as the research object, and the recognition algorithm of structural defect inspection robot is studied. A new method based on fuzzy support vector machine to automatically identify rivet crack defects in magneto-optical image of aircraft skin is proposed.

articleTitle: Simulation of Manipulator Control Model Based on Improved Differential Evolution Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: The goal of trajectory tracking control of the manipulator is to make the joints of the manipulator cooperate with each other through a certain control algorithm, and finally make the end effector reach the desired target position according to the pre-designed path, so as to complete the corresponding required tasks. For different fields, such as aerospace, power grid, agriculture, etc., the trajectory optimization requirements of the manipulator are also very different, which leads to different degrees of adjustment of the end pose of the manipulator. Industrial manipulator is a complex system with high nonlinearity, strong coupling and uncertain model, and its motion process is often repetitive. In this paper, a manipulator control model based on improved differential evolution (DE) algorithm is proposed, and the simulation experiment is compared with the standard PID algorithm. The simulation results show that this model can get a recall rate of 95.83<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">%</sup>, and the error is obviously reduced compared with the traditional algorithm. Compared with PID algorithm, the tracking trajectory, optimal trajectory and ideal trajectory of the improved DE algorithm are more similar with less error.

articleTitle: Research on Adaptive Cruise Control Strategy of Distributed Drive Intelligent Electric Vehicle
publicationTitle: 2023 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: With the increase in car ownership, a series of social problems have emerged, such as road traffic congestion, traffic accidents, energy demand and environmental pollution. How to solve the social problems brought about by the automobile has become one of the main focuses of current automotive researchers' research. At present, electrification, intelligence and integration of cars can effectively reduce energy consumption, reduce the psychological pressure of drivers and enable them to devote themselves to driving, thus improving driving safety and reducing the occurrence of traffic accidents. Taking the distributed drive vehicle as the research object, the spacing compensation strategy under ramp and curve conditions is designed by applying a non-linear variable time distance model for the multi-objective coordinated adaptive cruise problem, which improves the accuracy of the actual working space distance signal. From the perspectives of vehicle safety, comfort and energy saving, an adaptive cruise control (ACC) system based on the model predictive control (MPC) algorithm and hierarchical control is designed. Therefore, the following work has been completed in this paper: (1) The spacing strategy model based on VTH is designed for compensating ramps and curves to solve the problem that the distance detected by radar is less than the actual following distance on ramps and curves, which provides the premise for the correct control of ACC of distributed drive electric vehicles. (2) The improved MPC algorithm based on variable-step discretization method can improve the accuracy and real-time performance of ACC system on the basis of ensuring a long prediction time domain. (3) The torque distribution algorithm designed improves the driving efficiency of the vehicle by optimizing the distribution of driving torque on the premise of ensuring safe following. The simulation results show that the algorithm can meet the design requirements of safety, stability and economy of distributed drive electric vehicle ACC system.

articleTitle: Weakly-Supervised Point-Cloud Classification in Transmission Engineering
publicationTitle: 2023 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Laser point cloud technology is now widely used in power transmission engineering measurement operations. However, the raw point cloud data suffers from poor point cloud classification accuracy and lack of a large number of annotated samples. To address the problems mentioned above, the paper proposes a large-scale point cloud classification model based on weakly supervised learning. It is capable of capturing local information from point clouds at different spatial scales, and it enables the network to learn local features of different volume point clouds. Actually, it can accurately classify the point clouds of transmission engineering into ground, tower, line, insulator and jumper with 0.1% labeled training data, and realize the accurate semantics of each point cloud The results of the paper can significantly improve the efficiency of engineering operations.

articleTitle: Analysis of Ozone Spatial and Temporal Distribution Characteristics and Pollution Trend Prediction Based on Improved Particle Swarm Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: China's air pollution is becoming increasingly serious. In order to improve the understanding of the characteristics and rules of air pollution, and study the treatment of air pollution, based on information visualization technology and air quality information data, combined with Html5, Java Script and D3 programming interface, the characteristics and distribution rules of air pollution in China are visually displayed and analyzed. Ozone is one of the most common gases in the atmosphere and plays an important role in the stratosphere and troposphere. It is mature to analyze the spatial and temporal distribution characteristics of ozone column concentration by using satellite remote sensing data, but the research on the prediction of ozone column concentration is scarce. Ozone is a trace gas found mainly in two regions of the atmosphere. One is the troposphere 10 to 16 kilometers above the ground, accounting for about 10%. About 90 percent of the remaining ozone exists somewhere in the stratosphere, roughly from the tropopause to about 50 kilometers in the air. How to obtain the spatial and temporal information of ozone and predict the ozone concentration in the future through monitoring data, thus providing technical support for effective environmental governance, is a challenge facing interdisciplinary research in environmental and computer fields.

Author Keywords: Spatial and temporal distribution characteristics of ozone

articleTitle: A study of Autonomous Vehicle Behavior Decision System based on Fusion Model
publicationTitle: 2023 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: The commonly used behavior decision models of behavior decision systems are rule-based models and learning-based models, the former is highly interpretable and highly efficient, often used in industrial applications, but difficult to adapt to complex scenarios, the latter can solve some special scenarios of automatic driving, but the computational efficiency is low and the logic is uninterpretable, and it is rarely used in industrial applications. In this paper, the fusion architecture of behavior decision system model in autonomous driving is studied, the fusion scheme of rule model and learning model is designed, and the car is tested by autonomous driving simulation to test different behavior decision models in intersection scenarios and traffic vulnerable group scenarios, and the test results show that the fusion model scheme has better interpretability, accuracy and computational efficiency than a single model, which proves that the fusion model can solve the problems of incomplete coverage of a single rule model and excessive resource occupation of the learning model to a certain extent.

articleTitle: Engine Fault Diagnosis Method Based on Convolution Neural Network and BiLSTM
publicationTitle: 2023 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Aiming at the complex characteristics of engine fault and fuzzy boundary of fault area, a method of engine fault diagnosis based on convolution neural network and bidirectional LSTM is proposed. To explore the causes of common engine faults, a convolutional neural network feature extraction model is established, the modified linear unit is used to improve the over fitting problem of the model, and the SoftMax classifier is used to lock the fault area, and the long short-term is established Memory rural network model, the introduction of remaining life tag, using min max method to complete data preprocessing, adding a dropout layer in the bidirectional LSTM layer and full connection layer, removing the output value of hidden layer, obtaining the final fault diagnosis results, and using root mean square error and asymmetric score function to evaluate the reliability of the method. The simulation results show that the fault diagnosis has fast convergence rate, high diagnosis accuracy and strong applicability, which provides valuable technical reference for engine maintenance and maintenance.

articleTitle: The Application of IoT-Assisted Intelligent Transportation System
publicationTitle: 2023 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: With the application of more and more emerging technologies in the field of transportation, smart transportation emerges as the times require. Smart transportation not only has information collection and transmission of information, the analysis and decision-making of information, and the effective integrated application of information in traffic operation management make the traffic system more automated and traffic decision-making more intelligent, thus making traffic control more timely, convenient, efficient and safe. The combination of smart transportation and the Internet of Things (IoT) can further alleviate the current problem of poor traffic, and urban transportation, as an important part of urban infrastructure, plays an unusual role in urban transportation. Therefore, smart transportation will be the best way to solve the current traffic problems, and the development space and prospects are also great. This paper uses the Internet of Things technology to design the service star and hierarchical model of the intelligent transportation system. After building the transportation system database, the system login module is verified, and the path search of the command transportation system under the Dijkstra algorithm, the genetic algorithm and the ant colony algorithm is compared. The results show that the number of iterations of the ant colony algorithm is the least under the same path length, which proves that the ant colony algorithm is more suitable for the path optimization process of the intelligent transportation system.

articleTitle: Computer Network Routing Optimization Algorithm Based on Neural Network Model
publicationTitle: 2023 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Artificial neural network (ANN) is an intelligent system that imitates the information processing mode of human brain nervous system. It is a simplification, abstraction and simulation of human brain ANN, which can be used for large-scale parallel processing and distributed information storage, and has good adaptability, self-organization and strong learning, association and fault tolerance functions. Aiming at the problems of information packet loss and data transmission delay caused by the rapid growth computer network, this article puts forward a computer network routing optimization algorithm based on ANN model to solve the computer network routing optimization problem. The simulation results show that the improved computer network routing optimization algorithm can quickly optimize the computer network routing, and the optimization success rate is high, which meets the actual needs. Using the learning ability of ANN, the input features can be matched comprehensively, accurately and quickly, and good evaluation results can be obtained.

articleTitle: Research on Control Model Optimization of Mechanical Design System Based on Ant Colony Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: In the environment of increasingly fierce global competition, more and more engineers are aware of the importance of facility layout to the entire manufacturing system. With the development of social economy, mechanical design has become an important model for realizing social economy. In the process of mechanical design, it is necessary to promote system control through arithmetic methods, improve the comprehensive control and management capabilities of mechanical systems, and create good internal conditions for comprehensive management innovation of mechanical systems. and external conditions. In the process of implementing the mechanical design system, it is necessary to follow the requirements of mechanization to ensure that the control of the mechanical system can meet the requirements of system management, to ensure that the system model can be fully optimized, so that the management ideas can be combined with the management model. With the rapid development of computer simulation technology, virtual reality technology shows vigorous vitality, and it is being integrated into all walks of life. This paper adopts the ant colony algorithm, which is a new bionic evolutionary algorithm in the field of optimization. The algorithm adopts distributed parallel computing mechanism, which is easy to combine with other methods and has strong robustness.

articleTitle: Research on Laser Additive Manufacturing Process and Deformation of Titanium Alloy Based on Three-dimensional Virtual Simulation
publicationTitle: 2023 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: With the development of electrification industry and the breakthrough of computer technology, the digital “intelligent revolution” driven by the Internet and big data industry is coming soon. Laser additive manufacturing technology is a kind of additive manufacturing technology developed by laser technology. In this technology, laser is used as heat source, and materials are processed and formed by melting layer by layer, so as to finally obtain the required high-performance complex structures and parts. Simulation is a technology that uses computer software to simulate the actual environment for scientific experiment. The dynamic and steady-state simulation system based on two-dimensional or three-dimensional graphics and images has been widely used at home and abroad, and achieved good results. Titanium and titanium alloys have low density, high specific strength, corrosion resistance, creep resistance, good welding performance and excellent biocompatibility. They are widely used in aerospace, navigation, chemical industry, power generation, automobile, sports leisure, medical treatment and other fields. This paper explores the technology of realizing virtual experiment in the network teaching of mechanical basic experiment with VRML and Java technology, and expounds the challenges and tasks faced by laser additive manufacturing technology.

Author Keywords: laser additive manufacturing process and deformation

articleTitle: Pedestrian Detection Algorithm Using Local Feature Cascade Classifier in Traffic Scenes
publicationTitle: 2023 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Aiming at the low recognition rate of pedestrian detection algorithm in traffic scene, this paper designs a pedestrian recognition algorithm based on local feature cascade classifier. The pedestrian candidate area is extracted, and the imaging intensity of the scattered light in the camera sensor is calculated. A local feature cascade classifier is used to segment the image boundary, and the rectangular box whose height is smaller than the height of the HOG window is enlarged to design a pedestrian detection algorithm for traffic scenes. The experimental results show that the average recognition rate of the pedestrian detection algorithm proposed in this paper is 94.764%. The results show that the proposed method can achieve better pedestrian recognition in traffic scenes after introducing local feature cascade classifier.

articleTitle: Service Governance Algorithm for Power Grid Structure Optimization Based on Improved Deep Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Power grid intelligence plays an important role in the energy supply of smart cities, while there are problems and challenges such as low efficiency and high redundancy. In this study, the improved deep neural network algorithm is used to optimize the power grid structure. Based on sigmoid function, the algorithm proposed in this paper can effectively identify the input sequence to improve the accuracy of the algorithm. Finally, the algorithm is compared based on the real power grid structure data set environment in North America. The algorithm proposed in this paper is helpful to reduce the monitoring cost of smart grid and improve the reliability of wireless communication in power grid. The experimental results show that the algorithm based on improved deep neural network proposed in this paper can effectively optimize the structure and service management of power grid, and has high accuracy.

articleTitle: Pedestrian Occlusion Detection Method based on Human Image Segmentation
publicationTitle: 2023 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Improving pedestrian detection accuracy in occlusion is a priority for developing intelligent transportation and autonomous driving. Traditional pedestrian occlusion detection methods still need to achieve a more satisfactory level of accuracy for pedestrian detection. This paper aims to study a new method to improve pedestrian detection accuracy in an occlusion environment. The core idea of this method is to regard the non-portrait part of the detection object as interference, use portrait segmentation as a preprocessing method to remove the non-portrait part, and only keep the portrait part. After recalibrating the training and test data of the model, YOLOv5 is used for model training to obtain a higher-level recognition model. This paper uses real-life pedestrian data CVC-05 obtained from natural scenes for testing. The map0.5:0.95 obtained in this paper reaches 0.7739, which is significantly higher than other algorithm models and is of great significance to the field of automatic driving pedestrian detection.

articleTitle: Research on Vehicle Wireless Positioning Technology Based on Embedded System
publicationTitle: 2023 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Vehicle positioning is one of the three key technologies of intelligent transportation system. Under the background of new technology era, how to combine network information and intelligent processing to achieve fast and accurate positioning technology has become a hot issue in China's research. In this paper, the vehicle wireless positioning technology based on embedded system is studied. Combining with the hardware design of the system, the positioning algorithm of wireless sensor network is studied. Considering the characteristics of high real-time requirement of vehicle positioning, an improved positioning algorithm with small computation, fast computing speed and good positioning accuracy is proposed-Weighted Centroid Localization Algorithm (Weighted Centroid Localization Based on the Difference of Differential RSSI). The experimental results show that the improved algorithm in this paper is more accurate and can display the position information of the terminal node on the user interface. The research of this paper is of great practical significance for the vehicle positioning in the area which cannot be covered by satellite positioning system.

articleTitle: Multi-Label Text Classification Based on BERT and Label Attention Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2023 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: In natural language processing, multi-label text classification is a crucial task. Recently, many methods had introduced information related to labels, which had improved the classification effect of methods. This paper proposed a model that utilizes BERT and a label attention mechanism to effectively leverage the semantic information present in labels. Through fine-tuning of BERT, the textual and label data were transformed into vector representations, and then the label attention mechanism was employed to extract text features, which are more relevant to labels. Finally, a corresponding classifier was constructed to complete the classification task. Experiments show that compared with the baselines mentioned in the paper, the proposed method had an improvement on both AAPD and RCVl-v2 datasets, which proved the effectiveness of the proposed method in the multi-label text classification task.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Accounting Information System Based on Decision Tree Classification Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Decision trees are one of the most widely used models in classification applications. Compared with neural networks and Bayesian methods, decision trees do not need to spend a lot of time and thousands of iterations to train models, and are suitable for large-scale data sets. Through the establishment of innovative event-driven accounting information systems, combined with accounting information The collection and processing process strengthens the application of the new accounting information system in accounting, through the establishment of an event-driven accounting information system through innovation, combined with the collection and processing process of accounting information to strengthen the application of the new accounting information system in accounting, the accounting information system is enterprise information. An important part of the management system is the core of enterprise economic information. The server side completes the functions required by the traditional accounting information system, including system management, accounting, purchase, sales and storage management, centralized fund management, cost accounting, and overall budget management. A specific classification algorithm is proposed according to the characteristics of streaming data, which is a main research branch of streaming data classification. In order to comprehensively introduce the stream data classification algorithm based on decision tree, it is more and more important to obtain relevant knowledge or rules from the data, and various data mining techniques are proposed. At present, both users and the industry have put forward the idea of developing management software. However, since the starting point of domestic software design is not from the perspective of enterprise management information system, it will cause great obstacles to the transformation of financial software in the future.

Author Keywords: Classification algorithm based on decision tree

articleTitle: Research on the Method of Detecting the State of Generator Body by Robot
publicationTitle: 2023 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Turbine generator is one of the most critical devices in nuclear power plant. Ensuring its safe and stable operation through effective maintenance measures is a necessary condition to ensure the safety and benefit of nuclear power plant. Currently, the detection of the state of generator body by robot instead of generator rotor checking has been widely applied. To adapt to the detection in the air gap of stators and rotors of different generators, weight reduction should be considered in the design of robot body, and aviation grade aluminum alloy and other materials can be used; to ensure that the robot can walk in the generator bore with different sizes and radians, the mechanical structure with adjustable width and angle should be considered in the design; the design of robot system should include image recognition system, slot wedge tightness detection system, automatic deviation adjustment system, and capability of remote control through cables. Compared with other existing robots, the robot designed in this paper has more comprehensive functions and can better cope with the actual working conditions of different generators without rotor drawing.

Author Keywords: robot for generator detection without rotor drawing

articleTitle: Research and Implementation of Reactive Power Optimization Algorithm Based on Topology Layering
publicationTitle: 2023 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: How to further enhance the regulation ability of power grid and improve the efficiency of reactive power optimization has become a concern of power system researchers. Reactive power optimization control is the basic task of power network dispatching. However, when a single intelligent algorithm is used for optimization calculation, it is easy for the algorithm to be premature and fall into the trap of local optimum in the whole solution space, and there are some defects such as long calculation time and slow optimization speed in the later stage. Traditional reactive power optimization algorithm relies on accurate mathematical model, which has some defects, such as high requirements for optimization function, easy to fall into local optimum, and inability to deal with discrete variables accurately. In order to solve this problem, researchers introduce intelligent optimization algorithm into reactive power optimization. On this basis, the reactive power optimization effects of IEEE-14 and 30 power systems were compared and analyzed using this method. The results show that this method can reduce the active power loss of the system by 3.36% and 2.40%.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Damage Assessment System for Optical Fiber Intelligent Structure Based on RBF Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: The safety and reliability of optical fiber structure are the key factors to ensure the normal operation of the whole system, and slight damage can potentially cause catastrophic accidents. In order to avoid this situation, structural damage must be identified. At present, academic circles are actively developing new methods for structural health monitoring and damage analysis. In recent years, the intelligent method represented by RBFNN (RBF neural network) has been applied to structural damage diagnosis. In this paper, the damage assessment of optical fiber intelligent structure based on RBFNN is studied. Experiments show that the average time of the system in this paper is the shortest, with an average time of 24.09min, followed by the system in literature [5] with an average time of 71.03min, and finally the system in literature [8] with an average time of 75.90min. Therefore, the system established in this paper is more suitable for damage assessment of optical fiber intelligent structures. Therefore, it is an ideal method to apply RBFNN to signal processing in optical fiber intelligent structure.

articleTitle: Design and Development of Generator Non-Pumping Rotor Fault Detection Robot
publicationTitle: 2023 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: In the existing generator non-pumping rotor fault detection robots, there are functional defects, in view of such deficiencies, a generator non-pumping rotor fault detection robot with the most complete detection function at this stage has been developed. Firstly, the external dimensions and traveling mechanism of the robot are designed; Then, the corresponding hard and soft control systems were developed, including image recognition system, slot wedge tightness detection system, automatic correction system, etc., and the controller was developed to realize the wireless terminal control robot; Finally, laboratory tests and field tests proved the reliability of the generator non-pumping rotor fault detection robot. The generator non-pumping rotor fault detection robot developed in this project has the most comprehensive fault detection function, with automatic correction function, which increases reliability, can basically replace manual generator fault detection, and reduces the cost of generator fault detection.

articleTitle: A Pilot Directional Protection Method for Flexible HVDC Line based on the Polarity of High-Frequency Energy
publicationTitle: 2023 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Aiming at the problem that the protection of flexible DC transmission lines is vulnerable to the influence of fault current limiter and distributed capacitance, a pilot directional protection method of flexible DC transmission line based on the high-frequency energy is proposed. Firstly, by analyzing the fault transient model of the MM C, the impedance of the MMC is derived. On this basis, the fault component network of flexible DC transmission system that made of high-frequency impedance is constructed. Then, according to the positive and negative that high-frequency energy shows when internal and external faults occurs, a protection criterion is established. Finally, simulation results on RT _LAB (Real Time Lab) platform shows that, the proposed protection method can distinguish internal and external faults, and can act reliably under high-resistance fault. The proposed protection scheme ensures the safe and stable operation of the flexible DC transmission system.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of HTML5-based Mobile Sales Management System
publicationTitle: 2023 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: In recent years, the development trend of computer technology and mobile internet is unstoppable, which has affected all aspects of people's lives. In view of the market realities such as remote rural areas and poor information, the use of mobile phone sales system, through door-to-door service marketing, can provide convenience for customers and improve the modernization of sales management. The system uses modern information technology such as HTML5 and Webservice to change the traditional POS sales model and develop a mobile phone APP, which realises the functions of merchandise purchase, sales, returns, enquiries and Bluetooth printing. According to the role of the manager and salesman, the system sets the corresponding rights. The salesman conducts door-to-door sales to rural customers, and the manager can check the current marketing status in real time anytime and anywhere. In this way, the transformation of sales from extensive management to refined management has been realized, and the facilitation of sales management and the level of informatization have been significantly improved.

articleTitle: Optimized Operation Control Strategy for Air-conditioning Load of Micro-grid with Island Operation
publicationTitle: 2023 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: The large amount of air-conditioning load puts great pressure on the recovery of isolated microgrid. On the premise of not affecting the recovery ability of island load, an optimal operation control strategy of island air-conditioning load that can maximize user comfort is proposed. Considering the predicted data of fluctuating power output, load access and temperature change, the start and stop time and operating power of air-conditioning load are optimized from the whole time of microgrid island operation. The simulation results based on the improved IEEE13-node system show that the proposed optimal control strategy meets the user's comfort requirements while ensuring the power supply for the important loads of the island, and improves the flexibility of the island air-conditioning load control.

articleTitle: Design of Embedded Measurement and Control System for Aircraft Maintenance Simulator Based on Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: With the development of simulation technology, simulation training has been widely used. Helicopter simulation training has become an important part of helicopter training, and its position is becoming more and more important. In the hardware measurement and control part of simulation training, different ways are adopted, which makes it difficult to maintain the simulator. It is difficult for the maintenance staff of simulator users to have a considerable professional level to maintain the simulator. To some extent, it is difficult to repair the simulator failure in time. For the friction and gear clearance of the servo system, as well as the nonlinear, strong coupling and other nonlinear and uncertain factors of two-phase asynchronous motor, corresponding mathematical models are established. Aiming at the requirements of high precision, fast response and high stability of the instrument system, a fuzzy PID controller based on genetic algorithm (GA) optimization is designed. The measurement and control system is a distributed embedded system, which has the ability to work independently with a single card. Compared with the current PCI, VXI, PC104 and other bus products, it has many measurement and control channels, strong modularity and other advantages, providing a good platform for the simulator hardware measurement and control. The design scheme and functions of the measurement and control card are described.

articleTitle: Research and Application of Object Recognition Algorithm in Architectural Engineering Drawing Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Aiming at the current situation of mainly relying on manual identification, a method of computer automatic identification of electrical components in architectural and installation engineering drawings is proposed. Based on the integration of Structural Semantics, starting from the leading building components, in the reduced recognition space, combined with the characteristics of the current recognition level, the feature-based building symbol recognition method, symbol based grid recognition method, contour based node component recognition method, segment component recognition method based on association semantics, geometry based composite component recognition method and inheritance based information transmission method are adopted respectively, The subsequent recognition is completed under the constraints of the model, which can effectively eliminate the drawing noise and improve the recognition rate with a small amount of calculation. The proposed method for obtaining engineering quantity information is essentially based on the vectorization of construction drawings, identifying various graphic objects, classifying them by rotation, displacement and scale invariance, and then identifying and labeling semantics, associating planes, elevations and scales. Section diagram, so as to realize the acquisition of three-dimensional properties of architectural drawings and information of steel bars. This paper discusses the research on the automatic identification of non-orthogonal architectural drawings and the algorithm of construction quantities, and presents the algorithm formula for calculating construction quantities and the principle and block diagram of the automatic identification of architectural drawings.

articleTitle: Body Posture Detection Based on OpenPose and 3D Reconstruction
publicationTitle: 2023 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: 3D reconstruction is of great significance in our daily life. Application such as Computed Tomography(CT) in medical. OpenPose is an open source algorithm in Realtime Multi-Person 2D Pose Estimation. It is characterize by bottom-up and faster recognition speed. The most common use is to take a person of pictures to identify. It is tedious to take pictures of a person multiple times in all directions when people need to obtain human full body posture information. In order to solve this problem, our team spins around the person to record a video. The video will be segmented to obtain a two-dimension image dataset. The blur image in the image dataset will be sharpen though DeblurGAN-V2 algorithm. 3D human model will be reconstructed through the usage of openMVG(Open Multiple View Geometry) combines with openMVS(Open Multi-view Stereo). OpenPose human posture recognition algorithm will be used on the human model so as to solve the tedious problem above. The information obtained is relatively more comprehensive at the same time.

articleTitle: A Parameter Identification Method of Battery Equivalent Circuit Model based on Impedance Spectrum
publicationTitle: 2023 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: With the increasing application of lithium ion batteries, the importance of research including battery state of charge, life estimation and other aspects is also increasing. At present, these directions are mainly based on battery models. Battery models are mainly divided into two types: mechanism model and equivalent circuit model. The equivalent model has been applied more widely because of its simple structure, small number of parameters and small amount of calculation. In this context, a method of identifying parameters of equivalent circuit model based on battery impedance spectrum is proposed. Firstly, the equivalent circuit impedance expression is obtained through the model structure, and the characteristic points can be selected to calculate the parameters in the formula. Based on the measured impedance spectrum, the initial values of the model parameters were calculated by using the characteristic points, and then the initial values were substituted into the Levenberg-Marquardt algorithm to get the final solution. The method combines the impedance profile features with iterative optimization algorithm, which has the advantages of high identification accuracy and fixed identification results

articleTitle: An Traffic Flow Detection System Based on Improved YOLOv5 in Complex Weather Conditions
publicationTitle: 2023 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: For the traditional way to carry out the traffic flow recognition of the computing platform, it is difficult to achieve the demands of real-time detection in too many models. Therefore, an improved traffic flow recognition method based on YOLOv5 is proposed to address the lightweight model's problem of low detection accuracy. Firstly, we use the dark channel defogging algorithm to preprocess the deep learning samples. Secondly, the Slim-Neck module of GSConv is introduced to replace the Neck part in the YOLOv5 network, which is a lightweight convolution technique with a good balance of accuracy and detection speed. Finally, the CIoU Loss is used as the regression loss function of the target bounding box to speed up the convergence speed and improve the detection effect. The effectiveness of the improved YOLOv5 algorithm has a significant improvement in other detector comparison experiments. The results showed that the improved YOLOv5s are 2.2% more accurate and 14.2% faster than the original YOLOv5 algorithm. The improved yolov5 model can be better applied in practice.

articleTitle: Static and Modal Analysis of a Wearable Lower Limb Exoskeleton Rehabilitation Robot
publicationTitle: 2023 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: The wearable lower limb exoskeleton rehabilitation robot is an intelligent device designed to aid in the rapid rehabilitation of lower limb motor disabilities. The effectiveness of the rehabilitation is directly dependent on the stability of the exoskeleton rehabilitation robot. To investigate the motion stability of the exoskeleton rehabilitation robot, a prototype model was developed and analyzed for its motion process and static characteristics. Additionally, a vibration model of the lower limb exoskeleton rehabilitation robot was established, and the dynamic equation was solved to obtain its vibration characteristics. Finite element analysis and third-order modal analysis were also performed to further analyze the vibration characteristics. From the analysis, it was found that the deformation of the first three vibration modes during each gait phase was negligible, indicating that the material selection of the exoskeleton robot met stiffness requirements. The natural frequencies of the first three orders were determined, and the maximum deformation gradually decreased from top to bottom. The vibration mode at the waist was mainly characterized by small amplitude front and rear oscillations. The safety in frequency during motion was also verified.

articleTitle: Design of Automatic Control System for Mechanical Manufacturing Based on Improved Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: With the rapid growth of social sci & tech, the related technologies of machinery manufacturing industry are constantly upgrading, which brings new opportunities as well as challenges to machinery manufacturing enterprises. As a product of high-tech field, there are often many factors that affect the stability of electrical automation control system in the actual mechanical manufacturing process. In this paper, mechanical automation technology and its application in mechanical manufacturing are studied, and an automatic control strategy of mechanical manufacturing based on improved GA is proposed. The simulation results show that the errors of the proposed automatic control algorithm for mechanical manufacturing are small, and the accuracy rate is high, reaching 96.31%. It can be seen from the error and precision of different algorithms that the performance of the automatic control algorithm for mechanical manufacturing in this paper is relatively good. Because it has the characteristics of little dependence on the problem and can obtain the global optimal solution, it can be applied to the optimization process of fuzzy controller, and can effectively determine the better control rules and membership functions, which provides extremely favorable conditions for the establishment of fuzzy control system.

articleTitle: Construction of Condition Monitoring and Fault Diagnosis System for PMSM Drive System Based on DSP
publicationTitle: 2023 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: With the rapid development of power electronics technology, microprocessor technology and control theory, AC servo technology is applied to more and more production occasions. Among them, PMSM occupies a major position in AC servo system because of its superior control performance. The CNC machine tool is composed of machine tool body and CNC servo system. Servo system is an automatic control system with mechanical displacement as the direct control target. The feed servo system of CNC machine tool controls the cutting feed motion of each axis of the machine tool, and the servo system executes the motion instructions from CNC device. The essence of vector control is to control the motor speed by controlling the current. This method is easy to control and realize digitally, and can significantly reduce the harmonic component of the inverter output current and the harmonic loss of the motor. In this paper, the operating characteristics of the inverter-fed PMSM drive system under fault conditions are studied, and the current and torque waveforms of the DSP inverter switch element under open circuit and short circuit fault conditions are simulated and analyzed. The fault detection and diagnosis of the drive system can be further realized by analyzing the current and torque waveform characteristics under fault conditions.

articleTitle: Blind Image Restoration Based on Power Law
publicationTitle: 2023 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: The goal of blind image restoration is to recover the latent clean image from the observed blur version without complete prior information of the degraded factor. Commonly, blind image restoration employs the iterative algorithms, which are time-consuming, uncertain or divergent. This paper proposes a non-iterative blind image restoration algorithm based on power law (BRPL). BRPL focuses on a prevalent and significant class of point spread function (PSF) - Class G. The spectrum of most natural images follows the power law distribution. An isosceles model is designed to approximate the true image's spectrum. The PSF is estimated by comparing the spectrum of the blurry image with the reconstructed one. After that, the image is reconstructed by employing the obtained PSF and Wiener filter. The proposed algorithm is non-iterative, as a consequence it is ultrafast. The experiments show that BRPL estimates PSF more accurately and reduces ringing artifacts significantly compared with some existing algorithms. The quality of the restored images are improved remarkably. Moreover, BRPL works well in restored the color image.

articleTitle: The Construction of D-M Chaos Model and Its Application in Mixed Circuits Testing
publicationTitle: 2023 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: In order to seek a universal and simple test method to realize the embedded test of digital-analog mixed circuits, a new method based on D-M chaos model is proposed in this paper. First, starting with the characteristics of time series generated from a chaos model, the possible influence on the test results is analyzed. The D-M model not only has the characteristics of the discrete Tent (D-Tent) model, but also has a wide spectrum of signal sequences, and its correlation is small and close to the white noise. And then the model parameters are selected to generate the chaotic time series with optimal characteristics. Second, the test sequences of the analog circuit are constructed by the chaotic time series, and the simulation is carried out to load the vectors to the analog circuit, and the fault features of the output are analyzed. Finally, FPGA is adopted as an embedded controller of digital-analog mixed circuit tested object to validate the method. The results show that this proposed method can effectively identify the fault in digital-analog mixed circuits, and it has a great reference value to mixed circuit testing.

articleTitle: Multi-UAV Cooperative Reconnaissance Planning Based on Information Sharing
publicationTitle: 2023 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Aiming at the problem that multi-UAV provide reconnaissance services for multiple users at the same time, a new cooperative reconnaissance planning algorithm is proposed. The centralized task assignment strategy based on multi-user demand aggregation is adopted to avoid repeated reconnaissance of the same target. The information sharing strategy based on the demand of a single user is adopted to complete the reconnaissance information of a single UAV to avoid repeated visits of multi-UAV to the same user. An efficient multi-UAV cooperative path planning algorithm is designed to minimize the total energy consumption of multi-UAV. The simulation results show that compared with the traditional UAV reconnaissance method based on single user demand, the proposed method performs better in terms of energy saving, and with the increase of the information overlap rate and the number of users, the energy-saving effect is more significant.

articleTitle: Research on Sports Action Analysis and Diagnosis System Based on Grey Clustering Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: With the continuous improvement of the application requirements of computer vision technology, the research on human behavior understanding is very important. Human motion recognition has broad application prospects in the field of computer vision, especially in intelligent monitoring, human-computer interaction, virtual reality, and motion analysis. Human action understanding and recognition and motion segmentation are intuitively important to many intelligent systems, and are widely used in intelligent video surveillance, video analysis and retrieval. In the fields of human-computer interaction and robot, it is a hot issue in academia and industry. This paper mainly studies how to automatically identify the categories of human actions from video or three-dimensional motion capture data. Through the analysis of existing research work, in practical application, people prefer to provide the function that the coach can modify the parameters or even edit the actions directly with the mouse, so as to realize the coach's design and guidance of actions. Therefore, the research of human motion recognition has attracted more and more attention. At the same time, with the emergence of depth camera, the research of human motion recognition has been pushed to a new height.

articleTitle: Whale Optimization Algorithm Combined with Oversampling Technique for Imbalanced Issues
publicationTitle: 2023 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Many sampling-based data preprocessing strategies are proposed to resolve imbalanced problems. The essential principle of sampling is to generate minority samples or filter majority samples based on a raw unbalanced dataset and finally get a rebalanced dataset. Combining oversampling methods with whale optimization algorithm for imbalanced issues will enhance the performance of existing oversampling algorithms. WOA-Oversampling consists of two main steps: reconcile train set with a specific oversampling technique and find the best set from the balanced train set using WOA. The biggest advantage of the algorithm is that it will make full use of existing oversampling methods and procure perfect train set. Experiments conducted on 10 imbalanced datasets compared with four existing overs ampling methods demonstrate the effectiveness of the algorithm.

articleTitle: Construction of Railway Foreign Body Intrusion Monitoring System Based on Grid Extraction Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: With the rapid development of high-speed railway and high-speed train technology, the speed of high-speed railway trains and the increase of train density, how to ensure traffic safety becomes more and more important, which puts forward higher requirements for traffic safety guarantee system. At present, railway foreign body intrusion detection technology based on machine vision has become the main research method, especially the recognition algorithm based on supervised learning is widely used. As one of its subsystems, the foreign body intrusion monitoring system of high-speed railway plays an important role. System failure and false alarm will endanger the safety of passengers and trains and affect the running efficiency, so how to analyze and improve the reliability of the system becomes an urgent problem to be solved. Based on the investigation of the disaster monitoring system, this paper analyzes the problems of the disaster monitoring system and summarizes the system faults. Then the fault detection methods are proposed for the main faults. Finally, taking the rainfall monitoring system as an example, the suggestions and measures to improve the system reliability are put forward, and the relevant tests of the system reliability are carried out.

articleTitle: Research on Parametric Modeling and Simulation of Mechanical Products Based on Multi-Objective Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Parametric modeling and design of mechanical products is a multi-factor, multi-link and complex decision-making process, in order to shorten the development cycle of new products and improve the design quality to adapt to market competition. For most mechanical products, most of them belong to adaptive design, and only a small part need new design. With the continuous development of feature modeling technology, feature modeling technology and constraint-based parametric design technology are gradually integrated, and mechanical product parametric design technology, or constraint-based parametric feature modeling technology, has emerged. In this regard, this paper uses MOGA (Multi-objective genetic algorithm) to test the comparison between the model output and the actual output, and will implement software pipelining, loop unrolling and other optimization loop methods; The option is program-level optimization. The actual output value after optimization is better than the output value before optimization. It can be seen that the optimizer can access the whole program to understand the number of cycles, enable symbol debugging and assembly source statement debugging. Reasonable selection and combination of the above compilation options can directly affect or control the optimization process and improve the output code optimization performance.

articleTitle: Research on Image-text Fusion Retrieval Methods for Picture Books
publicationTitle: 2023 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: With the increasing development of social technology, the image data on the Internet shows an explosive growth. In a large number of complex and different databases, how to make better use of image features to achieve simple and efficient real-time retrieval is a new challenge we face. In recent years, image retrieval has begun to develop towards multi-feature fusion and specific application scenarios, but the addition of most text features relies on the text annotation of image information, and uses tags or description semantics for retrieval. In this way, the image information not mentioned in the image annotation will not be retrieved, and the requirements for the data set are relatively high. This paper proposes an image retrieval feature enhancement method fused with text features. Based on the spatial distance score weight, the text features are combined with the extracted VLAD (Vector of Locally Aggregated Descriptors) features to obtain the feature vector describing the image content. By adding text features contained in the image itself, the retrieval effect of images containing text information can be improved, and the retrieval accuracy of occluded images can also be improved to a certain extent, so that image retrieval achieves a relatively satisfactory effect.

articleTitle: A Robust Image Watermarking Algorithm in DCT Domain Based on Chaotic Projection
publicationTitle: 2023 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: As the internet technology advances, various types of digital products have become more open and transparent in the process of online transmission. At the same time, there have also been some issues of tampering, piracy, and infringement. The digital watermarking is a important and necessary means of copyright protection. This article mainly focuses on the issue of image privacy and copyright protection, and proposes a robust image watermarking algorithm in DCT (discrete cosine transform) domain based on chaotic projection. Firstly, the host image is divided into blocks through the block processing. Besides, we perform the DCT transform on each sub-block image. Performing complementary transformation on them and the watermark image to be embedded by selecting a appropriate coefficients. Finally, we use Arnold scrambling transformation and chaos mapping technology to encrypts watermark image, realizing the embedding and hiding of digital watermark images. The simulation results show that the embedded watermark image has good concealment and transparency, and it has strong resistance to Gaussian interference, JPEG compression and clipping attacks.

articleTitle: Research on Network Security Situational Awareness Prediction Method Based on Intelligent Learning Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
