abstract: With the rapid development of the Internet, the network has become an indispensable part of people's lives and has been widely used in daily life and work, but at the same time, computer technology is also facing great challenges. Hacker attacks, virus attacks and other problems have emerged one after another, and these security risks have brought us a series of serious impacts and hazards. The study of network security posture is important because it can improve network monitoring capabilities, emergency response capabilities and predict the development trend of network security. In order to do a good job in network security defence, based on improving the existing static defence mechanism, network security situational awareness enables efficient analysis of various network security-related data and threat intelligence, while traditional assessment and prediction methods have problems such as being highly subjective, requiring access to a priori knowledge as well as being difficult to process in the face of massive amounts of data and relying too much on human resources when facing a dynamically changing network environment. Therefore, the combination of intelligent learning algorithms in this study allows network security situational awareness to be developed in the direction of intelligence and automation as well. A Bayesian decision model and Class-Attribute Interdependency Maximization (CAIM) discretization algorithm are used for the study, which further improves the network security situational assessment method to a certain extent.

articleTitle: Realization of National Costume Pattern Recognition Algorithm Based on Edge Morphological Transformation
publicationTitle: 2023 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: The traditional dress culture of ethnic minorities in China is the precious wealth of the whole Chinese culture. However, under the influence of economic globalization, social modernization, the impact of modern clothing culture and other factors, China's traditional culture of ethnic minorities' clothing is facing the dilemma of disappearing or having disappeared. Protecting and Inheriting Ethnic Minorities' clothing culture has become a new topic of common concern in the society. At present, many scholars have studied the inheritance and protection of intangible cultural heritage and collected a large number of clothing images, but the processing of these clothing images is still in the traditional manual processing stage, and few people have studied the automatic classification and recognition of these clothing images. From the perspective of edge shape transformation, this paper extracts the totem region on the ethnic costumes by analyzing the characteristics of ethnic costumes images, extracts the characteristics of the totem image region, and finally classifies and recognizes various ethnic costumes totem images, so as to realize the automatic recognition and classification of ethnic costumes images, lay a good foundation for the information processing of ethnic costumes, and make contributions to the inheritance and protection of ethnic costumes culture.

articleTitle: Research on Alzheimer Classification Based on Convolutional Neural Network and Two-level Cascaded Style Transfer
publicationTitle: 2023 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Alzheimer's Disease (AD) is a neurodegenerative illness that has a gradual onset and develops progressively. It manifests clinically as a broad range of dementia symptoms such as memory deficiency, aphasia, apraxia, agnosia, a loss of visual and spatial skills, executive dysfunction, and changes in personality and behavior. Despite extensive study, the cause is still not known. With the disease's advance, symptoms may also include difficulties with language, disorientation, mood swings, a lack of motivation, self-neglect, and behavioral challenges. In this study, with the help of deep learning Methods, we diagnose the Alzheimer Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) which is classified into 4 types (Non Demented, Very Mild Demented, Mild Demented and Moderate Demented). First, use Residual Network (Resnet50) to get the baseline. Then, make images binarized and make it promoted to 90. Next, in order to solve the unbalanced dataset, we use Smote Algorithm. Finally, use Two-level Cascaded Style Transfer (TCST) to augment the dataset. The accuracy reaches 93%. The result is obtained that can be employed for a reliable diagnose of Alzheimer's disease.

articleTitle: Large-scale Log-based Failure Diagnosis of Server Groups: A Two-stage Mining Approach Based on Drain 3 and Weight-based Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: In recent years, cloud computing centers have developed rapidly due to the increasing number of big data services. However, large-scale server groups are also accompanied by a high incidence of faults, so it is unrealistic to rely on manual diagnosis. Therefore, the researchers try to mine the log files with machine learning algorithms to achieve automatic failure diagnosis. However, the unstructured properties of log data and the constraints that machine learning requires large training sets have become the stumbling blocks on the research road. In order to improve the effect of fault diagnosis, based on previous studies, this paper proposes a two-stage method: In the first stage, parsing logs by Drain3 which is used to extract and match the template of log messages. In the second stage, the model is trained and outputs predictions which are mixed based on the Weight-based optimization algorithm based on RandomForest and CatBoost. Thus, the prediction results are optimized. After comparative tests, the proposed approach outperformed the other nine approaches. Moreover, due to the synthesis of Bagging and Boosting algorithms, the robustness of this approach is also improved.

articleTitle: Study of 6-Pulse Bridge Rectification Control Strategy Considering the Influence of PID Control Parameters
publicationTitle: 2023 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: With the goal of “carbon peaking and carbon neutral”, power systems are gradually developing towards high proportional power electronics and ultra-high voltage DC transmission. In order to ensure the reliability, safety, flexibility and economy of the power supply, it is extremely important to study the control strategy of the power system transmission circuit. In this paper, based on the principle of a three-phase bridge fully controlled rectifier circuit constructed by Insulated-gate Bipolar Transistor (IGBT), the control system of the circuit is improved by using PID closed-loop control strategy to construct a 6-pulse bridge circuit applicable to ultra and extra-high voltage DC transmission converters. The simulation model of the PID-controlled three-phase bridge fully controlled rectifier circuit is built by Simulink, and the rectification output waveform is obtained to analyze the rectifying effect. Meanwhile, the step response performance indexes of the PI control strategy and PID control strategy are compared and analyzed, and the influence of the introduction of each parameter of P, I and D on the model is analyzed. The circuit designed has the advantages of outstanding rectification performance and stable control system, which is of great value to improve the performance of the converter and ensure the stability of the power supply.

articleTitle: Research on Automatic Generation of Social Short Text Based on Backtracking Pattern
publicationTitle: 2023 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of cyclic repetition and incoherence in text generated by the pre-trained language model based on Transformer, the backtracking pattern of phrase joint sentences is proposed to improve the generation performance of the model, by imitating the deletion and modification in the process of human writing. In the text generation process, phrase level and sentence level backtracking processes are added to control generation quality globally. The phrase level captures generation errors and tracks them through the 3–4 sliding window algorithm, controls word root selection at the word or phrase level, and improves text quality at the word level, the quality evaluator based on BERT is introduced into sentence level, which comprehensively judges the quality from fluency, consistency, redundancy and semantic correlation between sentences, and the evaluator score is used as the condition for backtracking resampling, so errors in the generation process can be detected and corrected. This method focuses on generation and adjustment, does not affect the training amount and generation mechanism of the model, and has certain universality. Based on the typical open language model GPT2 and the conditional language model PPLM, this paper realizes the high-quality generation of microblog text. Experiments show that after introducing backtracking, the model can towards expected quality direction without damaging the attribute consistency of the conditional model, and the text is more coherent and readable, which is close to human writing style. It provides a solution to improve the quality of social text generation.

articleTitle: Monocular Vision Aided Inertial Positioning Method based on Centroid Extraction Applicable to GNSS Denied Environments
publicationTitle: 2023 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Focusing on the issue that the continuous integrated inertial/visual positioning method requires high hardware requirements, which is adverse to low-cost applications, a monocular vision aided inertial positioning method is proposed. A vision aided inertial positioning error correction model is established, and the spatial relationship between the camera and the marker's centroid is obtained through visual motion estimation. On the premise that the coordinate of the marker's centroid is known, the inertial positioning error can be corrected. Taking the GPS trajectory as the ground truth and the sign on the pavement as the road marker, the field experiment was carried out by using the MEMS IMU and the monocular camera. Our results show that the positioning error decreases from several hundred meters to nearly 2 meters after adding visual information. Experiment demonstrates that the proposed method is valid, which provides a reference for positioning under the GNSS denied environment.

articleTitle: Research on a Visual Mounting System of Micro-TEC Components
publicationTitle: 2023 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of large position error and low efficiency of manual operation in the surface mounting process of micro-electronic components, there is a three-axis & R-axis surface mount system for micro-TEC components based on machine vision. The system combines nine-point calibration with vision, recognizing targets and obtaining feature points by using shape-based template matching algorithms. In addition, this paper proposes a method for measuring the precision of repeated positioning based on machine vision. Then the nonlinear optimization algorithm is used to establish the error compensation model and we embed it into the motion control to achieve the system with high repeatable positioning accuracy and high reliability. The triaxial & R-axis surface mount system can complete the mounting task of micro-TEC components, and thus it is of great significance to solve the mounting problem in the field of microelectronics.

articleTitle: A DL Intrusion Detection Method for Low-Rate Denial of Service Attacks
publicationTitle: 2023 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Denial of service (DoS) attacks is among the most harmful network threats. Low-rate DoS (LDoS) attacks feature good concealment and are likely to evade detection by conventional signal analysis-based methods. A LDoS attack detection method that combines the convolutional neural network and the gated recurrent unit is proposed in the present work. To evaluate the proposed method, we collect real user traffic from a university's website, label the traffic with LDoS attacks as normal traffic. In order to get the real attack traffic, this paper has collected some new LDoS attack programs, such as slowloris, slowhttptest, pwnlloris, torhammer and httplog, which can be obtained from public channels, and constructed a LAN environment that conformed to the working scenario of the program. By running the attack program, the attack traffic could be obtained. In a large sample scenario, the average detection rate of our proposed method can reach 98.68%. This article focuses on the research: the average detection rate of the detection method proposed in this article in the case that the security agency can only intercept a small number of attack samples. That is, in the small sample scenario, the detection of the collected traffic shows that the average detection rate of the proposed detection method can reach 89.54% in a small sample scenario. Its effective detection rate is obviously superior to the existing similar detection methods.

articleTitle: Research on a New-Style Omnidirectional Robot Steering Mechanism Design and Hybrid Force/Position Control Method
publicationTitle: 2023 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Over the past few years, there has been notable progress in the field of intelligent manufacturing industry, mobile robot technology has attracted more and more attention. In particular, omnidirectional mobile robots can move instantly in any direction and overcome the limitations of limited mobility in traditional mobile robots. Some current omnidirectional mobile robots typically use one driven motor and one steering motor to control the movement of each wheel. However, this design increases energy consumption and makes system control more challenging. ZHIGUO LU et al. proposed a new-style omnidirectional robot, that one motor per wheel is sufficient for achieving omnidirectional motion. However, due to the particularity of its structure, the robot cannot change its attitude, which is not conducive to functional expansion of the robot. This research proposes a novel steering mechanism for the new-style omnidirectional robot which use cooperatively Universal wheels and ordinary wheels, so as to solve the above problem. This design can not only realize efficient omnidirectional translation of the robot, but also make the robot change its attitude through rotation. Furthermore, to realize motion control reasonably, we propose a hybrid force/position control method for the steering mechanism to control robot rotation. Finally, the simulation and experiment validate the effectiveness and stability of the proposed control method.

articleTitle: DiffGZSL: Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Model for Generalized Zero-Shot Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Zero-shot learning (ZSL) explores the way transfer the seen classes knowledge to the unseen classes. However, in generalized zero-shot learning (GZSL) scenario, the test set includes unseen and seen class data, leading to the phenomenon that classification results will be more inclined to the seen class. To address this issue, generative-based approaches have shown strong performance. However, generative-based methods adopting GAN or VAE's models suffer from training instability in balancing their network components, degrading the sampling performance. Therefore, to generate more realistic unseen class samples, we give a new generative-based method, Diffusion Generalized Zero-Shot Learning (DiffGZSL), which is interpretable and more stable to optimize for CZSL and GZSL. Specifically, DiffGZSL adopts the diffusion model as the generative network in zero-shot learning. In addition, given that semantic information is the key to ensuring knowledge transfer from seen to unseen classes, both category and attribute guidance are incorporated to the sampling process to generate discriminative visual features. In practice, DiffGZSL shows excellent and competitive performance on four ZSL benchmark datasets against recent popular models in CZSL and GZSL cases. Besides the ablation and analysis experiment results show that our conditional guided sampling method which utilizes categories and attributes is effective.

articleTitle: Deep Knowledge Tracing with Multiple Features
publicationTitle: 2023 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Knowledge tracing is an important task in online education platform. It aims to evaluate students' knowledge status and predict their future performance based on students' historical learning data. The existing methods only use interaction (exercise-response pair) sequence as model input and do not make full use of rich data collected by the platform. This paper proposes a Deep Knowledge Tracing model with Multiple Features (DKTMF), which considers three types of data that are easy to collect in online education platform: response time, exercise text and heterogeneous data. First, the negative exponential function about the interval time between responses is used to simulate students' forgetting behavior according to Ebbinghaus forgetting curve. Second, BERT and SimCSE are used to obtain the semantic features of the exercise text, and then the semantic similarity of the exercise is further calculated. Then, XGBoost is used to conduct feature engineering for heterogeneous data. Finally, the above three features are introduced into the deep knowledge tracing model based on Transformer. The experimental results show the effectiveness of DKTMF. Compared with the existing model, the average increase in AUC and ACC is 7.51% and 4.92% respectively, which can more accurately predict students' performance.

articleTitle: Leveraging Token-Based Representation to Detect Lateral Movement
publicationTitle: 2023 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Advanced Persistent Threats (APTs) attacks have caused serious threat to organization and government networks. In the APT lifecycle, lateral movement is an important step towards higher levels of authority and sensitive data. Methods for detecting lateral movement are of great interest both in science and in industry. Existing lateral movement detection methods heavily rely on feature engineering and audit data aggregation, the accuracy of the model's detection is significantly influenced by the quality of feature extraction. To address this issue, we introduce an unsupervised attention-based GRU model that leverages event tokenization method to ensure accurateness, the model removes the ad-hoc feature engineering phases and focuses on the remaining ones with improved accuracy. our design's approach is more automated and robust to record vectorization compared with other similar methods. Finally, we develop a prototype called Event2Vec and conduct comprehensive experiments using publicly available datasets. Extensive analysis show that Event2Vec can accurately and efficiently detect attacks within our evaluation.

articleTitle: Segmentation of Cardiac MRI Images Based on nnU-Net
publicationTitle: 2023 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Cardiac MRI image segmentation is a critical task in medical image analysis, as it assists in the diagnosis of various cardiovascular diseases. The traditional segmentation methods, such as thresholding and clustering, are limited in accuracy and efficiency. Deep learning-based approaches have shown promising results in medical image segmentation. The nnU-Net model is a state-of-the-art deep learning architecture that has achieved excellent performance in various medical image segmentation tasks. In this study, we applied the nnU-Net model to cardiac MRI image segmentation and evaluated its robustness on the ACDC cardiac dataset. Our experiment results demonstrate that nnU-Net outperforms several other models, such as R50-Unet, R50-Attn Unet, and VIT, in terms of Dice value. The application of the nnU-Net model for cardiac MRI image segmentation has significant value in clinical practice, contributing to improved diagnostic accuracy and saving clinicians' time. The results of this study prove the feasibility of using the nnU-Net framework to process cardiac MRI data comprehensively.

articleTitle: Implicit Learning of Rotational Decoupling Detection Heads Applied to Remote Sensing Object Detection
publicationTitle: 2023 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Remote sensing image features complicated background, big image size, small object pixels, and variable object direction due to the arbitrary shooting angle. Conventional object detector has poor detection effect on remote sensing image, which is prone to missed detection and false detection. In view of this, an improved YOLOv5 object detection algorithm was proposed for remote sensing image. First, the C3 module was improved. The output feature information of each convolutional module was transmitted to the deep network, so as to preserve more fine-grained feature information and enhance the small object detection capability. The improved downsampling mechanism integrates convolution downsampling with maximum pooling downsampling mechanism in downs amp ling to separate foreground and background information while retaining feature information. A lightweight rotatory decoupling detection head with implicit learning was proposed to address the conflict between regression and classification, thus improving the network detection capability for objects in any direction. In the meantime, an implicit learning matrix was added to guarantee the lightweight detection head and improve the network detection accuracy for multiple tasks. According to experimental results, under the same model size, compared with the original YOLOv5 detection method, the detection accuracy and detection speed of the proposed method were improved by 8% and 15 frames, or 14.7%, respectively on DOTA-v1.5 data set, effectively improving the detection accuracy and speed in remote sensing image detection. The detection accuracy was increased by 3.5% on coco data set in natural scenario. The method herein can still effectively improve the detection accuracy in natural scenario, proving effectiveness of the modified YOLOv5 method.

articleTitle: State of Charge Estimation for Lithium Battery Via Attention and LSTM Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: The use of fossil fuels has the problems of non-renewable and environmental pollution. Lithium battery has the tremendous advantages of low self-discharge rate, extremely high energy density, high working voltage and zero memory impact. The State of Charge (SOC) is circumscribed as the remaining charge of the lithium battery (Li-ion), that indicates the driving range of a pure electric vehicle. Additionally, it is the basis for SOH and fault state prediction. Nevertheless, the SOC is incapable of measuring directly. In this paper, an LSTM + Attention network framework is proposed. The LSTM algorithm is accustomed to present the timing information and past state information of the lithium battery data. The Attention algorithm is used to extract the global information of features and solve the problem of long-term dependency. To ensure the diversity of feature extraction, the Attention algorithm in this paper uses multi-headed self-attentiveness. The CACLE dataset from the University of Maryland is used in this paper. Through the training of the model and the comparison, it is concluded that the LSTM + Attention algorithm networks proposed in this article can predict the value of SOC well. Meanwhile, this paper compares the LSTM + Attention algorithm with the LSTM algorithm, and also compares the LSTM + Attention algorithm with the Attention algorithm. Finally, it is concluded that the accomplishment of the network framework contrived is superior to the performance of these two algorithms alone. Finally, the algorithm has good engineering practice implications. The algorithm proposed provides a better research direction for future parameter prediction in the field of lithium batteries. It has a better theoretical significance.

articleTitle: Service Migration Strategy Considering Task Deadline in Edge Computing
publicationTitle: 2023 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: In mobile edge computing, due to the mobility of connected autonomous vehicles (CAV), service migration is required when the vehicle travels to a new location. Making the best migration decision will be a great challenge due to the uncertainty of the network environment, deadline constraints, and resource constraints. In this paper, we aim to optimize the service migration strategy for CAV users with different deadline tasks. We try to design a suitable service migration strategy to maximize the number of completed tasks under the constraints of service migration energy consumption and user offloading costs based on the deadlines of different types of tasks. Next, we propose an improved algorithm for particle swarm optimization that can better search for service migration strategy in late iteration. We use the proposed mobility model to simulate the generation of movement trajectories. Extensive experimental results demonstrate that our proposed solution can perform more tasks than other algorithms and can provide higher quality of service to CAV users.

articleTitle: The Evaluation Benchmark for SP ARQL Federated Query
publicationTitle: 2023 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: In SP ARQL federated query system, cardinality estimation is one of the most critical steps that affect query performance. In recent years, a large number of federated query cardinality estimation methods have been produced, which is particularly important for evaluating the performance of different methods. However, the existing research shows that there is no unified test benchmark when evaluating cardinality estimation methods, and the commonly used precision index Q-error has also been proved to be unable to generate the optimal query plan. In order to solve the above problems, this paper proposes a test benchmark (FQCEB) for SP ARQL federated query cardinality estimation. FQCEB consists of three components: benchmark data set, query generator and evaluation index, including 32 templates created manually, 1600 unique queries and more than 200K query subplans. The experimental results show that when the performance of radix estimation method is evaluated by using the test benchmark in this paper, it shows the applicability of the benchmark to various methods, and the P-error evaluation index in the benchmark shows the correlation with the query running time, and the correlation coefficient is as high as 85%, which proves that P-error is more suitable for evaluating the actual performance of radix estimation method than Q-error.

articleTitle: Multi-Strategy Improved Arithmetic Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: The Arithmetic Optimization Algorithm (AOA) represents a heuristic technique for optimization, exhibiting powerful local search capabilities. Nonetheless, it struggles with limited global search capacity and is prone to becoming stuck in local optima. Within this investigation, our team presents a Multi-strategy Enhanced Arithmetic Optimization Algorithm (MI-AOA) to surmount these constraints. The MI-AOA incorporates several improvement strategies: Enhancement of the acceleration function MOA to balance local and global search capabilities; improvement of the exploration phase using the Cauchy exploration strategy, which replaces the multiplication and division operators, providing a wider search range; and introduction of a random reverse learning strategy mutation to enhance population variety and avoid getting stuck in local optima. The proposed MI-AOA algorithm framework integrates these strategies, aiming to improve AOA's ability to escape local optima and strengthen global optimization capabilities. The framework consists of an initialization step, an iteration loop with exploration and exploitation stages, a best solution update process, and a mutation strategy. The results demonstrate that the MI-AOA is capable of achieving better global optimization performance compared to the standard AOA.

articleTitle: Optimization of Wireless Charging Power Transmission Efficiency Based on Decoupling Equivalent Circuit Model
publicationTitle: 2023 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: In recent years, electric vehicles have successfully entered the consumer market with many advantages such as energy conservation, environmental protection, environmental protection, and convenient maintenance. However, the drawbacks of traditional wired charging methods are becoming increasingly prominent, so the electric vehicle industry has increased its research and development efforts on wireless charging methods. Wireless charging is mainly based on the Faraday electromagnetic induction principle, which refers to the transmission of energy between the charger and the electrical device through a magnetic field instead of directly connecting them with wires. Wireless charging technology may become a key technology to completely break free from the bottleneck of high capacity and high-performance battery research and development. At present, wireless charging has huge development space, but due to the numerous manufacturers, it is not easy to uniformly optimize and improve on-board charging equipment. Therefore, optimizing the lower parts of the vehicle to improve the utilization of power resources is more feasible. In response to the problem of low transmission efficiency in current wireless charging systems, this paper first establishes a decoupled equivalent circuit model to simplify the system, and then establishes an optimization model to optimize the transmission efficiency of the wireless charging system. This article optimizes the wireless charging model of electric vehicles. This article uses adaptive Simpson integration method, Neumann formula, and other methods to theoretically calculate the wireless charging efficiency, and conducts experimental simulation on the model.

articleTitle: Self-Correcting Capsule Network on Remote Sensing Scene Classification
publicationTitle: 2023 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Most of the current capsule network methods have good classification effects mainly on simple content datasets such as MNIST and CIFAR10. However, for remote sensing scene images with complex objects, these methods cannot well resolve the main objects in the images, which in turn affects the recognition of scene categories. To address the above problems, this paper proposes a self-correcting capsule network with the ability to enhance the main object information contained in the features. First, the original features of the image are encapsulated into capsules. Then, the part extraction layer goes to learn the part information of the main targets in the scene and corrects the information of the primary capsule features, so as to parse the parts of different objects in the image. Since the traditional dynamic routing algorithms cannot be applied well in remote sensing scenes, in order to get the category information effectively, a class activation routing is proposed to act into the part capsules by learning the class activation weights in the original features, and using the routing to learn the spatial relationship between different parts to combine different part capsules to calculate the capsules rich in category information. The method in this paper effectively improves the classification performance of the network.

articleTitle: A-REA: Relation-Aware Graph Convolutional Network Entity Alignment Via a Differential Adjacency Matrix
publicationTitle: 2023 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Entity Alignment is the task of seeking entities with the same semantics from distinct knowledge graphs (KGs). Researchers have recently proposed Graph Convolutional Network (GCN) based approaches to achieve this task. Most existing GCN-based methods embed all the relations into an identical value, making the underlying loss on the diversity of the relationship. Relation semantics of entities and relation structure have benefitted the entity alignment task in the monolingual scenarios. This paper proposes a Relation-Aware Graph Convolutional Network with a Differential Adjacency Matrix (A-REA), which exploits the relation-specific semantics and structural information of entities in the KGs to promote the entity representations. The experiments on DBP-15K and DWY-100K datasets, including three cross-lingual subsets and two cross-knowledge graph sub-datasets, reveal that our approach leads to advance in entity alignment task in both the cross-lingual and cross-knowledge KGs. Discriminating the relation shows the effective signal for entity alignment, especially for the schema heterogeneity of different KGs.

articleTitle: Remote Sensing Image Classification Fusion Cross Convolution and Attention Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2023 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: With the continuous development of remote sensing technologies has led to the generation of high resolution remote sensing imagery data, which has created new opportunities and challenges for the classification of remote sensing images. To further enhance the distinguishability and local semantic capability of remote sensing images, this study proposes a cross-conference attention module that combines the cross-conference and attention mechanism, thereby improving the distinguishability of the images.In this method, 3D cross-convolution is used to find the potential location of key objects in remote sensing images to improve the global semantic ability, and then attention mechanism is used to enhance the key information of key objects to improve the discriminant feature ability. Secondly, the instance level loss is introduced to strengthen the local semantic description and assist the global loss function classification. The experimental results demonstrate that the method proposed in this study exhibits competitive performance in the task of remote sensing image classification.

articleTitle: Network Architecture Design: Large Kernel Is What You Need
publicationTitle: 2023 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: We revisited the principle of neural network architecture design and its bottlenecks. Since VGG, the number of parameters is exploding. People scarify the size and efficiency of neural networks for little increase in accuracy, which means the contribution per parameter is getting lower and lower. This study aims to seek a way to design neural networks wisely. Inspired by the achievements of Vision Transformer, we infer that the size of the Effective Receptive Field can significantly affect the performance and efficiency of neural networks. Based on RepLKNet's algorithms in accelerating large kernel computing and the structure of residual-assisted large kernel design, a method to break the bottleneck of convolutional neural networks is proposed.

articleTitle: Detection of Vocal Cord Disease Based on Local Contour Features of Laparoscopy Images
publicationTitle: 2023 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Vocal cord disease is usually manifested as throat discomfort, dysphonia and other symptoms. If not treated in time, it may lead to dyspnea, canceration and other serious consequences. Laryngoscope is a common examination method for detecting vocal cord diseases. It is urgent to design an intelligent method to automatically detect vocal cord diseases from laryngoscope images using computer technology, so as to reduce the workload of laryngologists and the dependence on a large number of professional laryngologists. In laryngoscopic images, the symptoms of vocal cord diseases are concentrated on the internal contour of the vocal cord, usually characterized by vegetations, sausage-like masses and small protrusions. The existing research on laryngoscope image classification has paid little attention to the role of vocal cord contour in the diagnosis of vocal cord diseases, and failed to effectively focus on the local fine-grained features contained in the internal vocal cord contour. In this paper, we study the detection of vocal cord diseases based on laryngoscopic images, and propose a new classification method of laryngoscopic images, that is, local contour feature (LCF) based on local vocal cord contour feature. LCF includes four stages: image segmentation to obtain the overall vocal cord contour, internal vocal cord contour segmentation to obtain the internal contour curve by comparing the changes of adjacent pixel values, extracting the potential features in the vocal cord internal contour, taking the tangent slope angle of each point on the contour as the potential features, and classification module. We carried out experiments on data sets constructed from real laryngoscope images. The experimental results show that the proposed method LCF can effectively improve the detection performance of vocal cord diseases, with an accuracy of 97.2%.

articleTitle: Learning to Leverage Multi-Scale and Multi-Level Features for Facial Expression Recognition
publicationTitle: 2023 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Recent years, intense research are done with remarkable results on the topic of Facial Expression Recognition (FER). However, extracting meaningful contextual features and aggregating discriminative representations to improve the FER performance are still challenging. To address the above problem, we formulate a simple yet effective multi-scale and multi-level features learning neural network for FER. In our work, the proposed method consists of multiple scale-specific branches and a scale-fusion branch that aims to mine the implicit complementary advantages across different scales and levels. Experiments are conducted on the dataset FER-2013 to verify the effectiveness of the proposed model. In the end, the model produces a 70.0% accurate rate in the experiment which has a better performance than the state of arts.

articleTitle: Design of a Control System for Greenhouse Solar Dryer
publicationTitle: 2023 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Drying is one of the crucial post-harvest procedures to prevent losses of agricultural products in the Philippines. For the longest time, farmers have employed open sun drying as the primary means for drying agricultural products according to their safe moisture level. However, inefficiencies of conventional drying paved the way for innovative drying methods such as greenhouse drying, albeit it still lacks flexibility in its system implementation in the country. In this paper, a comprehensive solution is presented by the proponents through designing a control system that would reduce the health risk posed to workers by exposure to high temperatures while increasing the flexibility of the Greenhouse Solar Dryer. Aside from incorporating temperature control to minimize safety hazards, the proponents have integrated the relationship of moisture to the load sensor by ejecting the trays of commodities using a linear actuator and linear guide once they reach the required weight dependent on its moisture content with the utilization of a Proportional Integral Derivative (PID) controller. In that way, the usage of the dryer and the time remaining for the day if there is any will be maximized for drying commodities and will make the system more efficient. As a result, by controlling the PWM driver to activate or deactivate the fan, the PID controller achieves the desired temperature. The difference between the setpoint temperature and the actual temperature, known as a temperature offset, can, however, affect the system. A faster response can be attained by increasing the proportional gain, but this comes with the risk of exceeding the setpoint temperature and achieving a higher temperature than desired.

articleTitle: TUDF-NeRF: Generalizable Neural Radiance Field via Truncated Unsigned Distance Field
publicationTitle: 2023 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Novel view synthesis is a classical research problem in computer vision and has been well studied in various ways. While recently proposed NeRF model achieves photo-realistic novel view synthesis result, traditional NeRF can represent only a single scene and is not able to generalize to novel scenes, which limits its application. This paper proposes TUDF-NeRF, a generalizable neural radiance field representation for high-fidelity novel view synthesis. This is achieved by modeling the volume density as the function of truncated unsigned distance field (TUDF) and predicting radiance field by feature matching. Compared with the existing methods that generalize NeRF to novel scenes, the TUDF based representation enforces the rendering results to be influenced only by samples near the surface instead of the whole space, which reduces the ambiguity during feature matching over low-texture areas and improves view synthesis quality. To further improve the quality of view synthesis over arbitrary views on novel scenes, this paper design a per-scene fine-tuning scheme that utilizes the gated recurrent unit (GRU) to fuse local information for global optimization. Extensive experiments demonstrate that TUDF-NeRF outperforms state-of-the-art view synthesis methods, and photo-realistic view synthesis over arbitrary view direction is achieved after per-scene fine-tuning.

articleTitle: Mixed Attention Multiple Instance Learning Applied to Remote Sensing Scene Classification
publicationTitle: 2023 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Unlike natural scenes, which are composed of a single object and the object distributed in the center of the image, the remote sensing scene is composed of multiple objects and each object is distributed in different positions of the image. Therefore, exploring the contribution of each object to the global classification in the remote sensing scene requires stronger feature extraction ability. However, the existing convolution neural networks only focus on local features, which is easy to cause the separation of local features and affects the classification performance of global features. In order to meet these challenges, this paper proposes a mixed attention research method based on the combination of local semantics and global semantics, that is, using lightweight networks to extract features for the construction of an end-to-end neural network based on the multiple instances pooling method of mixed attention. The lightweight network is composed of the D2-Net proposed in this paper, which uses the combination of dilated convolution and depthwise convolution to learn the characteristics under different receptive fields; The attention-based multiple instances pooling module is constructed by mixing self-attention with spatial attention and channel attention respectively to learn the relationship between semantics; By combining these two parts, the global classification loss is constructed to obtain a discriminative classification model. Experiments on three widely used remote sensing scene benchmarks show that the proposed method is effective.

articleTitle: Focused Crawler Method Based on ELMo Model and Extended Theme Terms Weight
publicationTitle: 2023 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Considering the problems of insufficient theme description and low accuracy of topic correlation calculation, this paper proposed a focused crawler method based on ELMo (Embedding from Language Models) word vector and extend theme documents. Extend theme description documents with subject words extracted from Web text and keep the word's weight. Elmo model is used to train word vector to improve semantic representation. Based on the above two points, the similarity computing formula is improved to make the accuracy better. articleTitle: Research on Damage Identification of Overhead Ground Wires in Cable Clips Based on ASTFA and Time-Frequency Entropy
publicationTitle: 2023 Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: The transmission of electric energy relies on the power steel strand, and the suspension clamp on the electrical tower is the key component of the power steel strand. The structure of the suspension clamp has a semi-closed feature, which makes the steel strands in the clamp more likely to have more hidden defects after being exposed to external effects such as wind load, rain erosion or lightning strikes. In order to effectively detect the status of overhead cables in the clamp section, a damage identification method based on ASTFA and the time-frequency entropy of the signal is proposed according to the common defect characteristics and guided wave characteristics of the cable. First, analyze the propagation characteristics of the guided wave in the steel strand; secondly, introduce the self-adaptive sparsest time-frequency analysis algorithm and time-frequency entropy to construct the damage assessment index, and calculate the finite element simulation signal to initially verify the index Effectiveness; Finally, laboratory and field experiments have proved the feasibility of this method. The results show that: (1) Low-frequency longitudinal guided waves are more suitable for steel strand detection. In this paper, the L(0,1) mode of 64kHz is selected. (2) As the degree of damage increases, the value of the damage assessment index increases, and the frequency of guided waves has a limited influence on the index value. (3) According to the experiment, the damage degree evaluation range is divided, the field test proves that the index is more reliable.
